title: Fragment: Crimson Beacon
obscured_text: The inscription answers with a distant heat, then smears into unreadable red.
It is waiting for a stronger name in the blood.
revealed_text: The Crimson Beacon is a call cast through the vascular dark. It does not shout. It teaches blood to recognize a chosen point as kin.
The fragment cautions that a beacon is also a confession. Anything listening through the same inheritance may notice the flare.
